observations.title: Exact deadline rejects old AI application editor after normal seat withdrawal
steps: Expired private OTP delivery was not reread or reset; normal resend produced a new challenge and one private read completed A normal login. This is fixture delivery expiry, not a failed product OTP verification.
A normally cancels confirmed place; UI explicitly retains group chat. B reloads original application: 1/2 confirmed, original 98-character draft intact and Send request enabled.
Read-only meal API proves closesAt instant 2026-10-22T16:00:00.000Z. Fresh run checkpoint has zero HTTP handlers and no AI/worker operation in flight.

Approved isolated clock advances exactly to stored closesAt; normal worker cancels insufficient meal. B submits previously open editor once: This meal was cancelled / not taking requests. Draft remains.
Compare after clock transition/before submit against after submit: applications1, meals1, seat_events3, messages3 identical count and sorted-row SHA256. No new B application.
This proves final deadline enforcement for the actual CANCELLED insufficient branch. It does not claim a still-OPEN-to-CLOSED branch, native reversal, or whole journey005 completion.
